7488b144ed387ca798b6f860f4ff410d289a2099.sourceText: 源码没有坡面正负高度相加抵消的步骤，也没有禁止这两个开关同时开启。它们可以同时执行，但坡面较低部分取绝对值后可能被当作障碍。`useSorting` 是地面估计方式，是否能上坡还取决于坐标轴、坡度、高度窗口、下游障碍阈值及车辆能力，不能保证“开启就能上坡”。
7488b144ed387ca798b6f860f4ff410d289a2099.translatedText: The source code does not have a step to cancel out the positive and negative slope heights by summing them, nor does it prohibit these two switches from being enabled at the same time\. They can be executed simultaneously, but the lower part of the slope may be treated as an obstacle after taking its absolute value\.`useSorting`is a ground estimation method\. Whether the vehicle can climb a slope also depends on the coordinate axes, slope angle, height window, downstream obstacle threshold, and vehicle capability\. It cannot be guaranteed that "enabling it will allow slope climbing\."

748f8ac3c8183fd68d9e03bd70c5524f0a58c928.sourceText: 这项指定初始对齐所依赖的机体系，不表示本节点输出底盘位姿。当前 MID360 挂在 `gimbal_yaw`，所以该 TF 包含底盘到云台、机械 yaw 和雷达安装关系；它随 yaw 变化，不随 pitch 变化。缓存时刻也不一定等于 Point-LIO 初始化时刻，需要核对启动时的位姿与关节状态。
748f8ac3c8183fd68d9e03bd70c5524f0a58c928.translatedText: The body frame on which this specified initial alignment depends does not represent the chassis pose output by this node\. The current MID360 is mounted on `gimbal_yaw`; therefore, this TF includes the chassis\-to\-gimbal, mechanical yaw, and LiDAR mounting relationships; it changes with yaw but does not change with pitch\. The cache time also is not necessarily equal to the Point-LIO initialization time, so the pose and joint states at startup need to be verified\.

74c2af84fa7b42d795bc4ba318beb80af9464061.sourceText:
* 普通变量存放的是数据,指针变量存放的是地址
* 指针变量可以通过" * "操作符，操作指针变量指向的内存空间，这个过程称为解引用
74c2af84fa7b42d795bc4ba318beb80af9464061.translatedText:
* An ordinary variable stores data, while a pointer variable stores an address\.
* A pointer variable can use the "\*" operator to access the memory space that the pointer variable points to; this process is called dereferencing\.
